research_contract.target: Measure whether a ten-Task Selection improves future-pass-rate fidelity over the complete eligible historical benchmark, locate each Selector inside the exact equal-budget random selection space, and separate representability, search density, and pre-origin learnability.
research_contract.primary_baseline: all eligible historical Task and Check refs without Selection
research_contract.primary_support_rule: Selector minus full-history mean loss is at most -0.02 and its paired 95% Origin-block interval is wholly below zero.
research_contract.development_scope: The previously inspected 75-Task SymPy counterfactual replay is a development source only. No result from this study is confirmatory or promotes a Runner default.
non_solutions: beating one random seed without beating the full-history baseline
using the hindsight oracle or best-of-m random search as a deployable algorithm
turning repeated resampling of the same twelve Origins into new evidence
selecting one favorable post-outcome hyperparameter as a validated rule
calling a low oracle loss proof of pre-origin learnability

design.random_reference: exact uniform distribution over all feasible ten-Task history subsets, computed from the four joint binary Agent-outcome categories

approach_registry.thesis: A full random loss distribution and elite frontier distinguish a dense good region from a lucky hindsight oracle.
approach_registry.decisive_test: The exact probability mass normalizes to one and independently agrees with exhaustive enumeration on small fixtures.

approach_registry.thesis: Pre-origin reference-Agent outcomes contain a temporally forecastable future performance vector that a ten-Task subset can match.
approach_registry.decisive_test: Fixed recent, exponential, or linear forecasts reduce macro-Origin MAE by at least 0.02 versus coverage without opening future outcomes.

approach_registry.thesis: Task-text embedding distributions contain temporal topic signal that facility-location or centroid coresets can use without Agent outcomes.
approach_registry.decisive_test: A fixed semantic rule reduces macro-Origin MAE by at least 0.02 versus coverage and remains directionally favorable on the last eight Origins.

approach_registry.thesis: Tasks with intermediate historical reference-panel pass rates preserve future Agent gaps or rankings better than full-history or coverage.
approach_registry.decisive_test: The fixed filter improves pairwise-gap MAE or recommendation regret without materially worsening future-pass-rate MAE.

approach_registry.thesis: Support or system bias, search sparsity, and accidental time alignment can be measured separately.
approach_registry.decisive_test: Report the continuous support lower bound, discrete oracle multiplicity, elite mass, and outcome-permutation controls without treating them as deployable evidence.

resources.raw_embedding_policy: ignored artifact only; commit model, usage, input and response digests, dimensions, and sanitized aggregate results
